do_pattern: Fixed nav with background blur on scroll
dont_pattern: Navigation that disappears on scroll

do_pattern: Active link has distinct color and underline
do_code: a.active { color: var(--primary); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--primary); }
dont_pattern: All nav links look identical

rule: Mobile nav uses full-screen overlay or drawer
do_pattern: Hamburger opens full overlay with large tap targets
dont_pattern: Tiny dropdown menus on mobile that are hard to tap

do_pattern: Show full path Home > Category > Page
dont_pattern: No way to navigate back from deep pages

do_pattern: Wrap animations in media query
dont_pattern: Forcing animations on all users regardless of preference

rule: Keep transitions under 300ms for UI feedback
do_pattern: Button hover transition fast and snappy
dont_pattern: Slow 1s+ transitions on interactive elements feel laggy

rule: Use easing functions not linear motion
do_pattern: Natural easing curves for movement
dont_pattern: Linear animation looks mechanical and unnatural

rule: Animate one property at a time
do_pattern: Translate or opacity — not both unless intentional
dont_pattern: Animating width height margin causes layout reflow

rule: Always use visible labels above inputs
do_pattern: Label above input always visible
dont_pattern: Placeholder-only labels disappear on focus users forget what field is

rule: Show error messages below the field
do_pattern: Red error text directly under the problem field
dont_pattern: Error summary at top of form only users lose track of which field

rule: Validate inline on blur not on submit
do_pattern: Validate field when user leaves it not on submit
dont_pattern: Validating only on submit forces user to re-read whole form

do_pattern: Use email tel number date input types
dont_pattern: Generic text inputs lose mobile keyboard optimization

do_pattern: Asterisk + legend Required fields marked with *
dont_pattern: Marking optional fields instead of required causes confusion

rule: Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for body text
do_pattern: Use contrast checker before shipping
do_code: WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 — use WebAIM contrast checker
dont_pattern: Light gray text on white backgrounds commonly fails WCAG

do_pattern: Tab order follows logical reading order
dont_pattern: Mouse-only interactions lock out keyboard users

do_pattern: Meaningful images get descriptions decorative get empty alt
dont_pattern: Empty alt on meaningful images or redundant file names

do_pattern: Custom focus ring clearly visible
dont_pattern: outline: none on focus breaks keyboard navigation entirely

rule: Color is not the only indicator
do_pattern: Use icon + color or text + color for status
do_code: Error state uses red + error icon + text not just red border
dont_pattern: Red border alone fails color-blind users

rule: Lazy load images below the fold
do_pattern: Images outside viewport load on scroll
dont_pattern: Loading all images on page load slows LCP score

do_pattern: WebP or AVIF for photos SVG for icons
dont_pattern: Using unoptimized PNG/JPG files for every image

do_pattern: Reserve space for images and embeds
dont_pattern: Images with no dimensions cause cumulative layout shift

do_pattern: One clear primary action per section
do_code: Contrasting color large size clear label
dont_pattern: Multiple equal-weight buttons users don't know what to do

do_pattern: Start with verb describe outcome
do_code: Get Started Free — Save My Spot — Start Building
dont_pattern: Submit — Click Here — Learn More (vague)

do_pattern: Min 44px height comfortable tap area
dont_pattern: Tiny buttons especially on mobile

do_pattern: Add microcopy under CTA button
do_code: No credit card required — Join 10000+ users
dont_pattern: Isolated CTA with no supporting context

do_pattern: 65-75 characters per line ideal
dont_pattern: Full-width text on large screens becomes hard to track

do_pattern: Comfortable reading line spacing
dont_pattern: line-height: 1.2 on body text feels cramped

rule: Limit font sizes to 3-4 in a system
do_pattern: Consistent type scale heading body caption
do_code: Use Tailwind text-sm text-base text-lg text-xl text-4xl
dont_pattern: Random font sizes everywhere no consistent scale

rule: Don't use all-caps for long text
do_pattern: All-caps only for labels badges short UI text
dont_pattern: Paragraphs or headings in all-caps kill readability

do_pattern: Base-8 or base-4 spacing system
dont_pattern: Random spacing values everywhere

do_pattern: Sections breathe with padding
dont_pattern: Sections crammed together no breathing room

do_pattern: Law of proximity for visual grouping
do_code: Label and input 4px apart section gap 48px
dont_pattern: Equal spacing between unrelated elements causes confusion

rule: Show loading states on async actions
do_pattern: Spinner or skeleton on button after click
dont_pattern: Button looks the same while processing user clicks again

do_pattern: Toast notification or inline confirmation
dont_pattern: Silent success user unsure if action worked

do_pattern: Helpful empty state with CTA
do_code: Illustration + text + button to add first item
dont_pattern: Blank white space when no data loaded

rule: Design for touch first then desktop
do_pattern: 44px minimum touch targets with space between
dont_pattern: Desktop-first design with tiny targets on mobile

do_pattern: Single column layout on small screens
dont_pattern: Horizontal scrolling tables and multi-column layouts on mobile

do_pattern: Thumb-friendly bottom nav on mobile apps
do_code: fixed bottom nav with 5 items max
dont_pattern: Top-only navigation on mobile forces one-hand stretching
